author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Plow pose as in the reference: raised hips at the top right, straight legs reaching back over the head, back down to the shoulders, arms along the floor, and a large head resting low beside the neck. The current drawing had a tiny r2 ring for the head that read as a dot or wheel, and no neck, so the figure did not read as a person.
omissions: Limbs are single strokes (house stick-figure style) instead of the reference's outlined tubes.
